devdoc.title: AlchemistV3

AccountNotHealthy().notice: An error which is used to indicate that an account is not healthy

AlchemistV3NFTAlreadySetError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that the NFT address for the Alchemist has already been set

AlchemistV3NFTZeroAddressError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that the NFT address being set is the zero address

AlchemistVaultTokenMismatchError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that the token address for the AlchemistTokenVault does not match the underlyingToken

BurnLimitExceeded(uint256,uint256).notice: An error which is used to indicate that a burn operation failed because the transmuter requires more debt in the system.

CannotRepayOnMintBlock().notice: An error which is used to indicate that a user is trying to repay on the same block they are minting

ERC20CallFailed(address,bool,bytes).notice: An error used to indicate that a call to an ERC20 contract failed.

IllegalArgument().notice: An error used to indicate that an action could not be completed because of an illegal argument was passed         to the function.

IllegalState().notice: An error used to indicate that an action could not be completed because the contract either already existed         or entered an illegal condition which is not recoverable from.

LiquidationError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that a liquidate operation failed because an account is sufficiaenly collateralized.

MissingInputData().notice: An error used to indicate that the function input data is missing

Unauthorized().notice: An error used to indicate that an action could not be completed because either the `msg.sender` or         `msg.origin` is not authorized.

UnauthorizedAccountAccessError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that a user is performing an action on an account that requires account ownership

Undercollateralized().notice: An error which is used to indicate that an operation failed because an account became undercollateralized.

UnknownAccountOwnerIDError().notice: An error which is used to indicate that the account id used is not linked to any owner

AdminUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when the administrator is updated.

AlchemistFeeVaultUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when the alchemist Fee vault is updated.

AlchemistV3PositionNFTMinted(address,uin.notice: Emitted when a new Position NFT is minted.

ApproveMint(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when `owner` grants `spender` the ability to mint debt tokens on its behalf.

BatchLiquidated(uint256[],address,uint25.notice: Emitted when account for 'owner' has been liquidated.

Burn(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when `sender` burns `amount` debt tokens to grant credit to  account owner `recipientId`.

CollateralizationLowerBoundUpdated(uint2.notice: Emitted when the collateralization lower bound (for a liquidation) is updated.

Deposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a user deposits `amount of yieldToken to `recipient`.This event does not imply that `sender` directly deposited yield tokens. It is possible that the         underlying tokens were wrapped.

DepositCapUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the deposit cap is updated.

DepositsPaused(bool).notice: Emitted when deposits are paused or unpaused in the alchemist.

FeeShortfall(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a fee-vault payout is short of the requested amount.

ForceRepay(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when `amount` of debt is force repaid from `accountId`.

GlobalMinimumCollateralizationUpdated(ui.notice: Emitted when the global minimum collateralization is updated.

GuardianSet(address,bool).notice: Emitted when a guardian is added or removed from the alchemist.

Liquidated(uint256,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when account owned by 'accountId' has been liquidated.

LiquidationTargetCollateralizationUpdate.notice: Emitted when the liquidation target collateralization ratio is updated.

LiquidatorFeeUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the liquidator fee is updated.

LoansPaused(bool).notice: Emitted when loans are paused or unpaused in the alchemist.

MinimumCollateralizationUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the minimum collateralization is updated.

Mint(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Emitted when `amount` debt tokens are minted to `recipient` using the account owned by `owner`.

MintAllowancesReset(uint256).notice: Emitted when all mint allowances for account managed by `tokenId` are reset.

PendingAdminUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when the pending admin is updated.

ProtocolFeeReceiverUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when the fee receiver is updated.

ProtocolFeeUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the protocol debt fee is updated.

Redemption(uint256).notice: Emitted when the transmuter triggers a redemption.

Repay(address,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when `amount` of `underlyingToken` are repaid to grant credit to account owned by `recipientId`.

RepaymentFee(uint256,address,uint256,uin.notice: Emitted when `amount` of debt is repaid from `accountId`.

RepaymentFeeUpdated(uint256).notice: Emitted when the repayment fee is updated.

SelfLiquidated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when account owned by 'accountId' has been self liquidated.

TokenAdapterUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when a new token adapter is set in the alchemist.

TransmuterUpdated(address).notice: Emitted when the transmuter is updated.

Withdraw(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Emitted when yieldToken is withdrawn from the account owned.         by `owner` to `recipient`.This event does not imply that `recipient` received yield tokens. It is possible that the yield tokens         were unwrapped.

acceptAdmin().notice: Allows for `msg.sender` to accepts the role of administrator.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.The current pending administrator must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalState} error.Emits a {AdminUpdated} event.Emits a {PendingAdminUpdated} event.

admin().notice: Gets the address of the admin.

alchemistFeeVault().notice: Gets the address of the alchemist fee vault.

batchLiquidate(uint256[]).notice: Liquidates `owners` if the debt for account `owner` is greater than the underlying value of their collateral * LTV.`owner` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.**Example:**```AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).batchLiquidate([id1, id35]);```

burn(uint256,uint256).notice: Burn `amount` debt tokens to credit the account owned by `recipientId`.`amount` will be limited up to the amount of unearmarked debt that `recipient` currently holds.`recipientId` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`amount` must be greater than zero or this call will revert with a {IllegalArgument} error.account for `recipientId` must have non-zero debt or this call will revert with an {IllegalState} error.Emits a {Burn} event.**Example:**```uint256 amtBurn = 5000;AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).burn(amtBurn, 420);```

calculateLiquidation(uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Calculates fee, net debt burn, and gross collateral seize,         using a single minCollateralization factor (FIXED_POINT_SCALAR scaled).

collateralizationLowerBound().notice: Gets collaterlization level that will result in an account being eligible for partial liquidation

debtToken().notice: Returns the address of the debt token used by the system.

deposit(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Deposit a yield token into a user's account.Create a new position by using zero (0) for the `recipientId`.Users may create as many positions as they want.An approval must be set for `yieldToken` which is greater than `amount`.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`amount` must be greater than zero or the call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Deposit} event.**_NOTE:_** When depositing, the `AlchemistV3` contract must have **allowance()** to spend funds on behalf of **msg.sender** for at least **amount** of the **yieldToken** being deposited.  This can be done via the standard `ERC20.approve()` method.**Example:**```address ydai = 0xdA816459F1AB5631232FE5e97a05BBBb94970c95;uint256 amount = 50000;IERC20(ydai).approve(alchemistAddress, amount);(uint256 tokenId, uint256 debtValue) = AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).deposit(amount, msg.sender, 0);```

getMaxWithdrawable(uint256).notice: Returns the maximum MYT shares that could be withdrawn from a position

getUnrealizedCumulativeEarmarked().notice: Returns cumulative earmarked debt including one simulated pending earmark window.

globalMinimumCollateralization().notice: Gets the global minimum collateralization.Collateralization is determined by taking the total value of collateral deposited in the alchemist and dividing it by the total debt.

liquidate(uint256).notice: Liquidates `owner` if the debt for account `owner` is greater than the underlying value of their collateral * LTV.`owner` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Liquidate} event.**Example:**```AlchemistV2(alchemistAddress).liquidate(id4);```

liquidationTargetCollateralization().notice: Gets the liquidation target collateralization ratio.This is the collateralization ratio that accounts are restored to after liquidation.

minimumCollateralization().notice: Gets the minimum collateralization.Collateralization is determined by taking the total value of collateral that a user has deposited into their account and dividing it their debt.

mint(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Mint `amount` debt tokens.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`amount` must be greater than zero or this call will revert with a {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Mint} event.**Example:**```uint256 amtDebt = 5000;AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).mint(amtDebt, msg.sender);```

mintAllowance(uint256,address).notice: Gets the amount of debt tokens `spender` is allowed to mint on behalf of `owner`.

mintFrom(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Mint `amount` debt tokens from the account owned by `owner` to `recipient`.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`amount` must be greater than zero or this call will revert with a {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Mint} event.**_NOTE:_** The caller of `mintFrom()` must have **mintAllowance()** to mint debt from the `Account` controlled by **owner** for at least the amount of **yieldTokens** that **shares** will be converted to.  This can be done via the `approveMint()` or `permitMint()` methods.**Example:**```uint256 amtDebt = 5000;AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).mintFrom(msg.sender, amtDebt, msg.sender);```

normalizeDebtTokensToUnderlying(uint256).notice: This is to handle decimal conversion in the case where underlying tokens have < 18 decimals.

normalizeUnderlyingTokensToDebt(uint256).notice: This is to handle decimal conversion in the case where underlying tokens have < 18 decimals.

pauseDeposits(bool).notice: Pause all future deposits in the Alchemist.`msg.sender` must be the admin or guardian or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {DepositsPaused} event.

pauseLoans(bool).notice: Pause all future loans in the Alchemist.`msg.sender` must be the admin or guardian or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {LoansPaused} event.

pendingAdmin().notice: Gets the address of the pending administrator.

poke(uint256).notice: Synchronizes the state of the account owned by `owner`.

redeem(uint256).notice: Redeems `amount` debt from the alchemist in exchange for yield tokens sent to the transmuter.This function is only callable by the transmuter.Emits a {Redeem} event.

reduceSyntheticsIssued(uint256).notice: Reduces syntheticTokensIssued by `amount`.This function is only callable by the transmuter.

repay(uint256,uint256).notice: Repay `amount` debt using yield tokens to credit the account owned by `recipientId`.`amount` will be limited up to the amount of debt that `recipient` currently holds.`amount` must be greater than zero or this call will revert with a {IllegalArgument} error.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Repay} event.**Example:**```uint256 amtRepay = 5000;AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).repay(amtRepay, msg.sender);```

resetMintAllowances(uint256).notice: Resets all mint allowances by account managed by `tokenId`.This function is only callable by the owner of the token id or the AlchemistV3Position contract.Emits a {MintAllowancesReset} event.

selfLiquidate(uint256,address).notice: Self liquidates the account owned by `accountId`.`accountId` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.`accountId` must be owned by `msg.sender` or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.`accountId` must be healthy (overcollateralized) or this call will revert with an {AccountNotHealthy} error.in the event that account is not healthy, the account can only be liquidated using the regular liquidation path. (i.e. liquidate(accountId))Emits a {SelfLiquidated} event.

setAlchemistFeeVault(address).notice: Set the alchemist Fee vault.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {AlchemistFeeVaultUpdated} event.

setAlchemistPositionNFT(address).notice: Sets the NFT position token, callable by admin.

setCollateralizationLowerBound(uint256).notice: Set the collateralization lower bound ratio.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {CollateralizationLowerBoundUpdated} event.

setDepositCap(uint256).notice: Set a new alchemist deposit cap.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {DepositCapUpdated} event.

setGlobalMinimumCollateralization(uint25.notice: Set the global minimum collateralization ratio.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {GlobalMinimumCollateralizationUpdated} event.

setGuardian(address,bool).notice: Sets the active state of a guardian.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {GuardianSet} event.

setLiquidationTargetCollateralization(ui.notice: Set the liquidation target collateralization ratio.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {LiquidationTargetCollateralizationUpdated} event.

setLiquidatorFee(uint256).notice: Set a new liquidator fee.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {LiquidatorFeeUpdated} event.

setMinimumCollateralization(uint256).notice: Set the minimum collateralization ratio.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {MinimumCollateralizationUpdated} event.

setPendingAdmin(address).notice: Sets the pending administrator.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {PendingAdminUpdated} event.

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: Set a new protocol debt fee.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {ProtocolFeeUpdated} event.

setProtocolFeeReceiver(address).notice: Set a new protocol fee receiver.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {ProtocolFeeReceiverUpdated} event.

setRepaymentFee(uint256).notice: Set a new repayment fee.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {RepaymentFeeUpdated} event.

setTokenAdapter(address).notice: Sets the token adapter for the yield token.`msg.sender` must be the admin or this call will will revert with an {Unauthorized} error.Emits a {TokenAdapterSet} event.

setTransmuterTokenBalance(uint256).notice: Sets lastTransmuterTokenBalance to `amount`.This function is only callable by the transmuter.

tokenAdapter().notice: Gets the address of the current yield token adapter.

transmuter().notice: Gets the address of the transmuter.

version().notice: Returns the version of the alchemist.

withdraw(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Withdraw `amount` yield tokens to `recipient`.`recipient` must be non-zero or this call will revert with an {IllegalArgument} error.Emits a {Withdraw} event.**_NOTE:_** When withdrawing, th amount withdrawn must not put user over allowed LTV ratio.**Example:**```address ydai = 0xdA816459F1AB5631232FE5e97a05BBBb94970c95;(uint256 LTV, ) = AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).getLoanTerms(msg.sender);(uint256 yieldTokens, ) = AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).getCDP(tokenId);uint256 maxWithdrawableTokens = (AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).LTV() - LTV) * yieldTokens / LTV;AlchemistV3(alchemistAddress).withdraw(maxWithdrawableTokens, msg.sender);```
